services.name: The Paso Robles Scenic Tour
services.desc: Experience the beautiful city of Paso Robles while being on board an authentic sidecar with one of our gentleman sidecarists. Paso Robles is one of the most historic communities in California. Discover the local area, one award-winning winery or brewery, and other various landmarks as you immerse yourself in Paso Robles' storied history and culture. services.name: Paso Robles Wine Tour (Best Seller)
services.desc: The idea of Sidecar Tours Inc came to us as we were looking for a fun and new experience for date night. We have always enjoyed visiting Wine Country, Wine tasting, and the backroad freedom on a motorcycle. We figured why not allow someone else to experience all of the things we love in a new way! One of the many things that makes Sidecar Tours unique is the modification of the standard motorcycle sidecar to accommodate two passengers. This accomplishment has led us to the World’s First and Only Tandem Sidecars.
